name: Facet
text: We should prioritize shipping a live HTML/CSS prototype tonight that integrates real API calls. This provides immediate visibility into how data interacts with the interface, enhancing user engagement and clarity. The trade-off is that some additional features may be delayed for future iterations, but delivering a functional prototype ensures we maintain speed and quality in user experience.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Shipping a live prototype tonight with real API calls risks exposing fragile dependencies to stakeholders, wasting time on firefighting instead of interface design. A static mockup with mocked API responses proves the same points without locking us into unstable contracts. Settle it by proving the API is stable tonight—otherwise, we ship the mockup.
